purpose.en: Match eight fictional exposures to possible routes and a control, without diagnosing anyone.
purpose.fil: Itugma ang walong kathang-isip na exposure sa posibleng daan at kontrol, nang walang diagnosis.

group_size.en: Triads (learner, partner, observer), rotating; staff observe each learner.
group_size.fil: Triad (learner, partner, observer) na umiikot; staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat learner.

materials.en: 2.3.1 Possible exposure cards (eight cards per triad)
materials.fil: 2.3.1 Mga card ng posibleng exposure (walong card kada triad)
Worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.1

materials.en: Job aid with local contacts filled in
materials.fil: Job aid na may nakasulat na lokal na contact

steps.en: Read BHW Jo's case aloud. Ask: "How could a germ travel here, without naming anyone's illness?"
steps.fil: Basahin nang malakas ang kaso ni BHW Jo. Itanong: "Paano puwedeng dumaan ang mikrobyo rito, nang hindi pinapangalanan ang sakit ninuman?"

steps.en: Model one card: name the possible route and one control or person to approach.
steps.fil: Mag-model ng isang card: sabihin ang posibleng daan at isang kontrol o taong lalapitan.

steps.en: Each learner sorts all eight cards and fills the worksheet; rotate roles so everyone is learner once.
steps.fil: Ayusin ng bawat learner ang walong card at punan ang worksheet; paikutin ang papel para maging learner ang lahat.

steps.en: Staff observe; give one strength and one retry action, then let the learner redo missed cards.
steps.fil: Mag-obserba ang staff; magbigay ng isang kalakasan at isang uulitin, saka ipaulit ang mga card na nakaligtaan.

debrief.en: What evidence on the card supports your route? What does the card not tell you?
debrief.fil: Anong ebidensiya sa card ang sumusuporta sa napiling daan? Ano ang hindi sinasabi ng card?

debrief.en: Who decides testing, treatment or extra precautions?
debrief.fil: Sino ang nagpapasya sa testing, gamutan o dagdag na pag-iingat?

observe.en: Explains all eight cards, distinguishes exposure from diagnosis and links prevention to the route.
observe.fil: Naipapaliwanag ang walong card, naihihiwalay ang exposure sa diagnosis at naiuugnay ang pag-iwas sa tamang daan.

output.en: One completed exposure worksheet per learner.
output.fil: Isang napunang exposure worksheet bawat learner.

alternative.en: Solo or low-resource: read the cards aloud and complete the worksheet on paper; arrange staff observation later.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa o kulang sa gamit: basahin nang malakas ang mga card at punan ang worksheet sa papel; mag-ayos ng obserbasyon ng staff sa ibang araw.

worksheet.en: Card / possible route / control or contact
worksheet.fil: Card / posibleng daan / kontrol o contact

purpose.en: Propose source, environment, work-practice and PPE controls for a BHS scene, each with an owner.
purpose.fil: Magmungkahi ng kontrol sa pinagmulan, kapaligiran, gawain at PPE para sa BHS, may responsable ang bawat isa.

group_size.en: Triads, rotating; staff observe each learner.
group_size.fil: Triad na umiikot; staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat learner.

materials.en: 2.3.2 Layered control map cards and worksheet
materials.fil: Mga card at worksheet ng 2.3.2 Mapa ng magkakaugnay na kontrol
Talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.2
Job aid

steps.en: Read the crowded-queue case. Ask: "If we only hand out masks, what problems remain?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ng siksik na pila. Itanong: "Kung mask lang ang ipamimigay natin, anong problema ang maiiwan?"

steps.en: Model one row of the map with a proposal and the person who must confirm it.
steps.fil: Mag-model ng isang hanay ng mapa na may mungkahi at taong dapat magkumpirma.

steps.en: Each learner completes all four rows: source, environment, work practice, PPE.
steps.fil: Punan ng bawat learner ang apat na hanay: pinagmulan, kapaligiran, gawain, PPE.

steps.en: Check that no row changes ventilation, isolation or clinical care without the responsible person; give one retry action.
steps.fil: Tiyaking walang hanay na nagbabago ng bentilasyon, isolation o clinical care nang walang responsable; magbigay ng isang uulitin.

debrief.en: Which row was hardest to fill? Who owns it at your BHS?
debrief.fil: Aling hanay ang pinakamahirap punan? Sino ang responsable rito sa BHS ninyo?

observe.en: Includes all four types, appropriate owners and no unauthorized clinical or engineering changes.
observe.fil: May kontrol sa apat na uri, malinaw na responsable at walang sariling pagbabago sa clinical o engineering na proseso.

output.en: One four-row control map per learner.
output.fil: Isang mapa na may apat na hanay bawat learner.

alternative.en: Solo: complete the map for a fictional BHS and review it with the supervisor.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa: punan ang mapa para sa kathang-isip na BHS at ipasuri sa supervisor.

worksheet.en: Type / proposal / owner or confirming person

purpose.en: Choose the appropriate method and show complete handwashing and handrub, including drying.
purpose.fil: Piliin ang angkop na paraan at ipakita ang kumpletong handwash at handrub, kasama ang pagpapatuyo.

group_size.en: Triads at hand-hygiene stations; one staff observer per station.
group_size.fil: Triad sa hand-hygiene station; isang staff observer bawat station.

materials.en: Running water, soap, single-use towels, alcohol-based handrub and a timer per station
materials.fil: Umaagos na tubig, sabon, single-use towel, alcohol-based handrub at timer bawat station

materials.en: 2.3.3 method cards (visibly dirty / not visibly dirty) and checklist
materials.fil: Mga card ng 2.3.3 (may nakikitang dumi / walang nakikitang dumi) at checklist
Talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.3

steps.en: Read Lea's case. Ask: "Which method first, and why?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Lea. Itanong: "Anong paraan muna, at bakit?"

steps.en: Model the complete handwash and the complete handrub once, following the lesson checklist.
steps.fil: Mag-model nang isang beses ng buong handwash at buong handrub, ayon sa checklist ng aralin.

steps.en: Each learner draws a card, names the method and demonstrates; the observer marks every checklist row.
steps.fil: Bubunot ng card ang bawat learner, sasabihin ang paraan at magde-demonstrate; mamarkahan ng observer ang bawat hanay ng checklist.

steps.en: Name any missed surface or step and have the learner repeat the whole procedure.
steps.fil: Pangalanan ang nakaligtaang bahagi o hakbang at ipaulit ang buong procedure.

debrief.en: Which surfaces are easiest to miss? What will remind you at work?
debrief.fil: Aling bahagi ang madalas makaligtaan? Ano ang magpapaalala sa inyo sa trabaho?

observe.en: Appropriate method; all surfaces of both hands; complete timing and drying; no recontamination.
observe.fil: Tamang paraan; lahat ng bahagi ng magkabilang kamay; kumpletong oras at pagpapatuyo; walang muling kontaminasyon.

output.en: A completed checklist for both methods per learner.
output.fil: Napunang checklist para sa dalawang paraan bawat learner.

alternative.en: No running water on site: practise the sequence and handrub, then arrange the handwash demonstration with the supervisor at a working station.
alternative.fil: Walang umaagos na tubig: sanayin ang pagkakasunod at handrub, saka ayusin ang handwash demonstration sa supervisor sa gumaganang station.

worksheet.en: Step / handwash / handrub (observed, retry, not observed)
worksheet.fil: Hakbang / handwash / handrub (naobserbahan, ulitin, hindi naobserbahan)

purpose.en: Show tissue and elbow covering, disposal and hand hygiene, then explain respectful reporting.
purpose.fil: Ipakita ang pagtakip gamit ang tissue at siko, pagtatapon at hand hygiene, saka ipaliwanag ang magalang na pag-uulat.

group_size.en: Triads, rotating; staff observe each learner.
group_size.fil: Triad na umiikot; staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat learner.

materials.fil: Tissue at basurahan
Handrub o handwashing station
Mga card, worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.4

steps.en: Read Mang Lito's case. Ask: "How does Rina help him without embarrassing him?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Mang Lito. Itanong: "Paano siya tutulungan ni Rina nang hindi napapahiya?"

steps.en: Remind everyone: mime only; never cough or spit toward a partner.
steps.fil: Paalalahanan ang lahat: kunwari lang; huwag umubo o dumura sa kapareha.

steps.en: Each learner mimes the tissue method and the elbow method, disposes of the tissue and cleans hands.
steps.fil: Ipakita ng bawat learner ang tissue at siko, itapon ang tissue at linisin ang kamay.

steps.en: The learner then says, as Rina, how they would report symptoms to staff; give one retry action.
steps.fil: Sasabihin ng learner, bilang si Rina, kung paano iuulat ang sintomas sa staff; magbigay ng isang uulitin.

debrief.en: What words help a resident without shaming them?
debrief.fil: Anong salita ang nakakatulong sa residente nang hindi siya napapahiya?

observe.en: Covers nose and mouth, discards tissue, cleans hands and explains respectful reporting.
observe.fil: Natatakpan ang ilong at bibig, naitatapon ang tissue, nalilinis ang kamay at naipapaliwanag ang magalang na pag-uulat.

output.en: A completed step checklist per learner.
output.fil: Napunang checklist ng hakbang bawat learner.

alternative.en: Solo: rehearse the sequence and the reporting words, then demonstrate to the supervisor later.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa: sanayin ang pagkakasunod at ang sasabihin sa pag-uulat, saka ipakita sa supervisor sa ibang araw.

worksheet.en: Step / observed, retry or not observed
worksheet.fil: Hakbang / naobserbahan, ulitin o hindi nakita

title.en: Household food, water and sanitation review
title.fil: Pagsusuri sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon ng bahay

purpose.en: In a household role-play, identify food, water and sanitation risks and agree on safe changes and what to confirm.
purpose.fil: Sa role-play sa bahay, tukuyin ang panganib sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon at magkasundo sa ligtas na pagbabago at dapat ipakumpirma.

group_size.en: Triads: BHW, household member (Mila), observer; rotate.
group_size.fil: Triad: BHW, miyembro ng pamilya (Mila), observer; paikutin.

materials.en: Mock household corner or picture of Mila's home
materials.fil: Kunwaring sulok ng bahay o larawan ng bahay ni Mila
Mga card, worksheet at talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.5

materials.en: Job aid with the local water advisory or contact
materials.fil: Job aid na may lokal na water advisory o contact

steps.en: Read Mila's case. Ask: "'The water looks clear.' What do we say?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Mila. Itanong: "'Malinaw naman ang tubig.' Ano ang sasabihin natin?"

steps.en: The BHW asks permission, then names what they see in the food, water and toilet areas.
steps.fil: Hihingi muna ng pahintulot ang BHW, saka babanggitin ang napansin sa pagkain, tubig at palikuran.

steps.en: Together they agree on one change per area and write who must confirm water safety.
steps.fil: Magkakasundo sila sa isang pagbabago bawat bahagi at isusulat kung sino ang magkukumpirma sa kaligtasan ng tubig.

steps.en: Stop any guessed chlorine amount, boiling time or 'clear means safe' promise; give one retry action.
steps.fil: Pigilan ang panghuhula ng dami ng chlorine, oras ng pagpapakulo o pangakong 'malinaw kaya ligtas'; magbigay ng isang uulitin.

debrief.en: Which change did Mila choose herself? Why does that matter?
debrief.fil: Aling pagbabago ang si Mila mismo ang pumili? Bakit mahalaga iyon?

observe.en: Proposes appropriate food, water and sanitation changes without guessed treatment or appearance-based guarantees.
observe.fil: May angkop na pagbabago sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon; walang hinulaang treatment o garantiya mula sa hitsura.

output.en: A three-row household plan with a confirming person.
output.fil: Plano ng bahay na may tatlong hanay at taong magkukumpirma.

alternative.en: Low-resource: use the printed story instead of a mock corner; solo learners complete the worksheet and review it with the supervisor.
alternative.fil: Kulang sa gamit: gamitin ang naka-print na kuwento sa halip na kunwaring sulok; ang mag-isa ay pupunan ang worksheet at ipasusuri sa supervisor.

worksheet.en: Area / observation / chosen improvement / confirming person

purpose.en: Complete the BHS policy and training checklist with location, version, owner, role and training gaps.
purpose.fil: Punan ang policy at training checklist ng BHS: lokasyon, bersiyon, responsable, tungkulin at kulang na training.

group_size.en: Triads, rotating; staff observe each learner.
group_size.fil: Triad na umiikot; staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat learner.

materials.en: Sample IPC folder with some old pages
materials.fil: Sample na IPC folder na may lumang pahina
Policy at training checklist ng 2.3.6
Talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.6

steps.en: Read Nilo's case. Ask: "He found the sterilization policy. May he now sterilize equipment?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Nilo. Itanong: "Nakita niya ang sterilization policy. Puwede na ba siyang mag-sterilize?"

steps.en: Model the hand-hygiene row: location, version to confirm, owner, training still needed.
steps.fil: Mag-model ng hanay ng hand hygiene: lokasyon, bersiyong ikukumpirma, responsable, training na kailangan pa.

steps.en: Each learner completes the sample checklist and marks old guidance, the missing contact and two specialist tasks.
steps.fil: Punan ng bawat learner ang sample checklist at markahan ang lumang gabay, kulang na contact at dalawang gawain para sa specialist staff.

steps.en: Check that no training is marked complete without evidence; give one retry action.
steps.fil: Tiyaking walang training na minarkahang tapos nang walang ebidensiya; magbigay ng isang uulitin.

debrief.en: Which items at your BHS would you need to ask about first? Who would you ask?
debrief.fil: Aling item sa BHS ninyo ang unang itatanong? Kanino?

observe.en: Records location, version, contact and training gaps without inventing training or authorization.
observe.fil: Naipapakita ang lokasyon, bersiyon, contact at training gaps nang walang imbentong training o awtorisasyon.

output.en: A completed sample checklist per learner.

alternative.en: Solo: complete the checklist and have the supervisor review it before using it at the actual BHS.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa: punan ang checklist at ipasuri sa supervisor bago gamitin sa totoong BHS.

worksheet.en: Topic / location or version / owner / role or training gap
worksheet.fil: Paksa / lokasyon o bersiyon / responsable / tungkulin o training gap

worksheet.en: Training topic / needed for my role? / completed or evidence / next step
worksheet.fil: Training topic / kailangan sa papel ko? / natapos o ebidensiya / susunod na hakbang

purpose.en: Record one IPC gap, prompt reporting, an owner, a date and follow-up evidence without inventing results.
purpose.fil: Itala ang isang IPC gap, agarang pag-uulat, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya ng follow-up nang walang imbentong resulta.

group_size.en: Triads, rotating; staff observe each learner.
group_size.fil: Triad na umiikot; staff ang nag-oobserba sa bawat learner.

materials.fil: Blangkong 2.3.7 IPC improvement card
Talaan ng obserbasyon ng 2.3.7
Job aid

steps.en: Read Aya's case. Ask: "'Everyone attended, so we are fine.' Is that true?"
steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso ni Aya. Itanong: "'Okay na tayo dahil lahat ay dumalo.' Totoo ba?"

steps.en: Model a specific observation: place, time and what was seen.
steps.fil: Mag-model ng tiyak na obserbasyon: lugar, oras at nakita.

steps.en: Each learner completes the card, including the person informed, interim arrangement, owner and date.
steps.fil: Punan ng bawat learner ang card, kasama ang taong sinabihan, pansamantalang kaayusan, responsable at petsa.

steps.en: Give two follow-up outcomes (resolved, unresolved); the learner records each honestly with the next action.
steps.fil: Magbigay ng dalawang follow-up (naayos, hindi pa); itatala ito nang tapat ng learner kasama ang susunod na hakbang.

debrief.en: What is the difference between a promise and evidence?
debrief.fil: Ano ang pagkakaiba ng pangako at ebidensiya?

debrief.en: Close the subchapter: one route, one control, one person you will report to.
debrief.fil: Isara ang subchapter: isang daan, isang kontrol, isang taong pag-uulatan.

observe.en: Records a specific gap, report, owner, date and evidence; distinguishes promises from observed results.
observe.fil: May tiyak na gap, pag-uulat, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya; naihihiwalay ang pangako sa naobserbahang resulta.

output.en: A completed improvement card with both follow-up outcomes.
output.fil: Napunang improvement card na may dalawang follow-up.

alternative.en: Solo: complete a blank card for a fictional station with the supervisor.
alternative.fil: Mag-isa: punan ang blangkong card para sa kathang-isip na station kasama ang supervisor.

worksheet.en: Place, date, time / specific observation / person informed / interim arrangement
worksheet.fil: Lugar, petsa, oras / tiyak na nakita / kanino iniulat / pansamantalang kaayusan

worksheet.en: Action, owner, date / measure / follow-up A resolved: evidence / follow-up B unresolved: next action
worksheet.fil: Gawain, responsable, petsa / panukat / follow-up A naayos: ebidensiya / follow-up B hindi pa: susunod na hakbang
